items.title: SC asks HDFC, ICICI bank to grant prosecution sanction in subvention fraud
items.rss_summary: The Supreme Court on Thursday directed HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Sammaan Capital and PNB Housing Finance to grant unconditional sanction for prosecution of their officials within a week in alleged subvention scheme frauds involving real estate developers, banks and financial institutions. A bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana warned that the heads of these financial institutions would have to personally appear before it in case of non-compliance. "We direct all the banks or financial institutions referred to above to issue unconditional sanction for prosecution within one week, failing which the CMD and Chairman shall remain present in court to show cause as to why appropriate action be not taken against them," the bench said in its order. Under the subvention scheme, banks disburse the sanctioned amount directly to the accounts of builders, who are then required to pay the EMIs until the flats are handed over to homebuyers. items.hinglish_title: Subvention Fraud: Supreme Court Ka HDFC Aur ICICI Ko Ek Hafte Ka Ultimetam
items.explanation: Supreme Court ne HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Sammaan Capital aur PNB Housing Finance ko ek hafte ke andar apne officials ke khilaf prosecution sanction dene ka nirdesh diya hai. CJI Surya Kant ki bench ne chetavni di ki non-compliance par bank ke CMD aur Chairman ko court mein hazir hona hoga. Subvention scheme mein banks seedha builders ko amount bhejte the jinhe homebuyer ke possession lene tak EMI bharni thi, jisme alleged fraud hua hai.
